headline: A Ukrainian military analyst says twelve AI-controlled gun turrets are now set up in Kyiv to shoot down Shahed drones.
score_reason: Notable use of autonomous guns around a capital, but one unofficial source and no technical detail.
importance_line: Kyiv residents are the people affected, as the analyst advised keeping away from windows during alerts, but there is no official confirmation or performance data.
summary: UA.NEWS reports, citing military analyst Serhiy "Flash" Beskrestnov, that twelve Ukrainian-designed turrets with AI-controlled machine guns have been installed in Kyiv to shoot down Russian Shahed drones, with more planned. The claim comes from one analyst and has no official confirmation or performance figures in the text.
notes: Single-source claim by a named analyst, not an official statement; headline calls them 'rocket-propelled' but the text only says Shahed drones.
